name: Marius Hills Hole and rille
provider: NASA LRO LOLA / PDS Geosciences Node
units: m relative to LOLA 1737.4 km reference radius; constant offset cancels in local terrain derivatives
observation_coverage: not quantified by the gridded product; production method includes surface interpolation
missing_data_semantics: The PDS label defines no missing-value sentinel; no fill code is inferred. The gridded image does not distinguish interpolated from directly constrained cells.
uncertainty_note: LOLA GDR is a shape/radius map. Its label states gridding used surface interpolation in higher-resolution regions. Product does not supply a per-pixel confidence layer; measurement uncertainty is therefore unquantified.
processing_method: Bounded byte-range crop and metric-grid reprojection; no whole-planet file downloaded
